### Headline summary
- A reported breach of an unclassified CIA system marks a significant escalation in US government cyber incidents. ([Cointelegraph.com News](https://cointelegraph.com/news/hackers-breach-cia-intelligence-network-in-latest-us-cyberattack?utm_source=rss_feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/an-unclassified-cia-system-was-breached-in-a-cyberattack-ap-source-says/))
- CISA added three actively exploited vulnerabilities to its catalog, including flaws in Idunno and other software. ([US-CERT](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/11/24/cisa-adds-three-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203882/hacking/u-s-cisa-adds-n-able-mailassure-and-project-monai-flaws-to-its-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog.html))
- Major data breaches affected McDonald's Japan, LaLiga, and the Colorado state government, exposing sensitive user data. ([The Record](https://therecord.media/japan-mcdonalds-cyberattack-breach), [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/mcdonalds-japan-data-breach-exposes-customer-location-information/), [The Record](https://therecord.media/laliga-hacked-spain-top-professional-league-confirms-cyber-incident), [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/la-liga-says-football-fans/))

### Hackers breach CIA intelligence network in latest US cyberattack
The reported breach follows cyber incidents involving the FBI, Department of Homeland Security and Department of Agriculture. ([Cointelegraph.com News](https://cointelegraph.com/news/hackers-breach-cia-intelligence-network-in-latest-us-cyberattack?utm_source=rss_feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound))

### An Unclassified CIA System Was Breached in a Cyberattack, AP Source Says
It was not clear what specific information was compromised or who was responsible. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/an-unclassified-cia-system-was-breached-in-a-cyberattack-ap-source-says/))

### CISA Adds Three Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
CISA has added three new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog , based on evidence of active exploitation. CVE-2026-131914 Idunno AntiCsrf Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability CVE-2026-132165 Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability CVE-2026-132224 O… ([US-CERT](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/11/24/cisa-adds-three-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203882/hacking/u-s-cisa-adds-n-able-mailassure-and-project-monai-flaws-to-its-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog.html))

### McDonald’s Japan discloses breach exposing customer purchase and location data
McDonald’s Japan disclosed a cybersecurity breach that exposed customers’ purchase histories and mobile device location data. ([The Record](https://therecord.media/japan-mcdonalds-cyberattack-breach), [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/mcdonalds-japan-data-breach-exposes-customer-location-information/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/mcdonalds-japan-data-breach/))

### LaLiga hacked: Spain’s top football league confirms theft of fans’ personal data
Spain’s professional soccer league LaLiga said Monday hackers stole personal information belonging to fans in a cyberattack affecting its digital services and those of several Spanish clubs. ([The Record](https://therecord.media/laliga-hacked-spain-top-professional-league-confirms-cyber-incident), [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/la-liga-says-football-fans/))

### Colorado says cyberattack took down myColorado app, warns 150,000 had data stolen
Cybercriminals likely stole data from 150,000 users of myColorado, which residents typically use for digital identification, document storage and accessing state government services. ([The Record](https://therecord.media/mycolorado-app-down-data-breach))

### Microsoft Fixes Azure API Management Classic Flaw as Actor Targets Customer Secrets
Norway's National Security Authority (NSM) has disclosed that it became aware of a security vulnerability in Microsoft's Azure API Management (APIM) that has affected multiple businesses in the country, including energy companies Equinor and Skagerak Energi. "An unknown actor has been actively look… ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/microsoft-fixes-azure-api-management.html), [CSO Online](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4252513/attackers-exploited-an-azure-api-management-flaw-to-steal-secrets-microsoft-warns.html), [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/24/azure-apim-vulnerability-credential-theft/))

### Rackspace shuts down Spot cloud platform after security breach
Rackspace is shutting down its Rackspace Spot cloud platform after a security breach allowed hackers to access customer Kubernetes clusters and secrets, giving customers until December 8 to migrate their services and download their data. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/rackspace-shuts-down-spot-cloud-platform-after-security-breach/))
